text:
Made a small stylized grass tool with Codex and @threejs 
You can paint directly on the ground to control where the grass grows, and tweak things like density, noise and direction.
Still a work in progress, but it’s already pretty fun to play with.
#ThreeJS #WebGL #CreativeCoding https://t.co/93b4zhf25y
